high_level_description: The image features a person standing against a textured, metallic gold curtain backdrop. The individual is wearing a stylish, off-the-shoulder, short dress that is primarily burgundy with a white trim at the neckline and hem. The dress has a velvet-like texture and is adorned with a small decorative brooch on the left side of the chest, which appears to be a festive design, possibly involving holly or a similar motif. The person has long, dark hair styled straight and falls over their shoulders. They are posing confidently with their hands on their hips, exuding a sense of elegance and poise.
